paper_title: Pulsar Polarization Array Limits on Ultralight Axion-like Dark Matter
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling as plotted on y-axis
notes: First pulsar polarization array (PPA) analysis for ultralight axion-like dark matter detection using 22 millisecond pulsars from Parkes PTA DR3. The paper constrains the Chern-Simons coupling g_agamma via cosmic birefringence effects on pulsar polarization. Abstract and main text state best global limits of ≲10^-13.5 to 10^-12.2 GeV^-1 for the fuzzy DM mass range 10^-22 to 10^-21 eV with ρ_0 = 0.4 GeV/cm^3. The lower bound (10^-13.5 GeV^-1) corresponds to m_a ≈ 10^-22 eV and the upper bound (10^-12.2 GeV^-1) to m_a ≈ 10^-21 eV. Data points represent the approximate endpoints of the stated exclusion range. The analysis uses full pulsar cross-correlation and advanced Bayesian framework with comprehensive noise modeling. Local DM density is explicitly set as benchmark value for this haloscope-type experiment. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 52)) | Vision: Figure 2 shows 95% upper limits on ALDM Chern-Simons coupling g_agamma as a function of mass m_a.
